mechanism: Cenobamate inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing tramadol metabolism and increasing tramadol levels while potentially decreasing active metabolite formation, combined with additive CNS depression and serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Monitor closely for increased tramadol adverse effects (dizziness, sedation, seizure risk); consider tramadol dose reduction and avoid concurrent use if possible; educate on seizure precautions and serotonergic symptoms.
